in_marathi.name: Mokshika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Liberation from suffering
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mokshika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mokshika is a Sanskrit name derived from the root words 'moksha' (liberation) and 'ika' (one). It symbolizes the quest for spiritual enlightenment and liberation from the cycle of birth and death. The name is associated with the goddess Laxmi, who is believed to grant moksha (salvation) to her devotees.
